uncertain: Only the front elevation is drawn, so REAR/LEFT/RIGHT openings are marked not shown. From the plan: RIGHT 2 windows (bedrooms 11.20, 11.79); REAR (stepped) 4 openings - bathroom 5.19 narrow window, bedroom 13.88 corner glazing, living-room glazed wall, kitchen rear glazing; LEFT (stepped) 3 - bedroom 13.88 corner return, living-room glazing, kitchen glazing. The render confirms the rear ones.
Render 4 (and thumbnail 2) is captioned 'wizualizacja frontowa' but shows the rear/garden side; front was taken from the entrance facade of the drawings.

Only two overall chains are printed; every inner vertex (kitchen front line 4.20, garage left face 9.85, kitchen rear 9.38, living-room left face 2.48 and rear 12.98, bedroom left face 7.25 and rear 17.60, bathroom block left face 11.16) is TRACED at ~21.7 px/m (one pixel ~4.6 cm), estimated +-0.1 m.
Glazed walls (living room rear, bedroom corner, kitchen corner) were taken at the outer faces of their corner piers.

An L-shaped double-line band (~0.7 m wide) runs along the rear edge of the terrace zone (~18.7-19.4 m from the front, beyond the 18.71 chain) from the bathroom block to ~2.6 m from the left and then down to the terrace's rear line at ~17.2 m; its meaning is not identifiable (canopy fascia edge, low wall or planter). The render shows no roof over the lounge area, so the terrace is recorded as unroofed, with doubt.

Entrance landing between the kitchen front and the garage (~3.8 x 3.5 m incl. steps): whether it is roofed (e.g. by an overhang of the east-wing roof, whose front gable spans from ~7.7 m) is not shown.
No roof plan, side or rear elevation: ridge lengths, the position of the east-wing front gable relative to the garage front, and the extent of the living-zone roof are UNKNOWN.
Chimney count differs: 2 stacks in the elevation, 1 chimney in the render.
The grey diagonal shape across the yellow panel and left wall in the front elevation reads as the cast shadow of the projecting garage, not a building element.

Kitchen front window: one ~3.5 m opening on the plan, two panes with a mullion in the elevation - counted as one window. The entrance door appears to have a narrow side light - counted as one ENTRANCE_DOOR.
Pool, deck steps and paving appear only in the render. The render also shows panels (solar or glazing?) on the east-wing roof's left slope - not identifiable.
Traced outline area 202.8 m2 vs published built-up 202.66 m2 (check only, not used to fit).
